description: This file declares the interface for a time tracking utility, providing functions to create, destroy, start, stop, and query timers that measure elapsed time and expiration status.

methods.name: timeTrackerCreate
methods.description: Creates a new time tracker instance; must be released using timeTrackerDestroy.

methods.name: timeTrackerDestroy
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a time tracker.

methods.name: timeTrackerStart
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified timeout in seconds.

methods.name: timeTrackerRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is still running.

methods.name: timeTrackerExpired
methods.description: Checks if the timer has expired.

methods.name: timeTrackerSecondsUntilExpiration
methods.description: Returns remaining seconds before the timer expires, if started.

methods.name: timeTrackerElapsedSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds the timer has run or is running.

methods.name: timeTrackerDebug
methods.description: Provides debugging information for the timer.
